# Web game engineering

WebGPU and performance, procedural environments, multiplayer, playtesting and analytics, testing 3D apps, accessibility/i18n/PWA, and game feel.

Stars checked 2026-09-23. Notes: [notes/game-engineering.md](../notes/game-engineering.md). Sync locally: `node scripts/sync.mjs --category game-engineering`
